name: Menu Bar Reveal
title: Show your hidden Mac menu bar with a shortcut | Menu Bar Reveal
tagline: A single icon for your menu bar.
summary: A free, open source Mac app. Press your keyboard shortcut and the hidden menu bar comes down. Press it again and it goes back up.
shareImageAlt: A tabloid front page, Menu Bar Reveal, pasted on a painted wall in the middle of a yellow sun. The headline: SWIFT JUSTICE. Under it, a big red app icon, a bar over a down arrow, and a yellow box: GET IT ON GITHUB. A painted figure points at the page. Beside it, a small poster of a waiter serving a menu bar on his palm.
